module: Web/WebSocket server to display the game's interface on an external device (phone). On load, it starts via utils/wsUtils a server on port 8084 (protocol 'bng-ext-app-v1', page /ui/entrypoints/main/index.html), over HTTPS/WSS so that the phone's motion sensors are accessible, and publishes the URL to the UI via guihooks.trigger('externalUIURL', url). Usage: extensions.load('ui_extApp').
notes: Stream data is handled on the C++ side; _handleData only logs an "unknown command" error for any JSON message received.
The server listens on all addresses ('any'); the announced address is the one chosen by wsUtils.createOrGetWS.
On unload, externalUIURL is emitted with no argument to clear the URL on the UI side.

requestUIData.desc: Sends the server URL back to the UI (guihooks.trigger('externalUIURL', url)). Alias of updateUIData.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: creates or gets the WebSocket/HTTPS server, logs the URL and publishes it to the UI.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: destroys the server (BNGWebWSServer.destroy) and clears the URL on the UI side.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: reads the events from the WebSocket peers, decodes the JSON messages of type 'D' and passes them to _handleData (which logs an error because everything is handled in C++).
